does: Draws the eye to the intense, fiery light at the center, contrasting with the muted tones of the surrounding areas.
Creates a sense of depth through the layering of smoke, water reflections, and distant structures.
refuses: To define the figures and architecture with sharp detail, leaving them impressionistic.
To use a consistent color palette, instead emphasizing the clash of warm and cool tones.
reading.tension: The interplay between the destructive energy of the fire and the calm, reflective surface of the water creates a dynamic yet unresolved contrast.
materialFacts: The surface is dominated by loose, sweeping brushstrokes that blend colors together.
The paint layers are thin in some areas, allowing the texture of the canvas to show through.
The reflections in the water are rendered with horizontal strokes, mirroring the fiery sky above.
structuralMoves: The composition is divided horizontally by the river, with the fire and sky occupying the upper half and the water the lower.
The bridge acts as a central axis, connecting the foreground to the distant background.
The crowd on the left and the boats on the right create a balance of activity across the scene.

leakage.work: The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons, October 16, 1834
